title: FIPS observability: lookup silent when FIPS mode active but no non-FIPS provider registered
description: crypto2dev_lookup_algo() only emits the FIPS-mode diagnostic (pr_info_ratelimited at line 316-318) when skipped_non_fips is non-NULL — i.e., when a non-FIPS provider was traversed and skipped. When FIPS mode is active but only FIPS providers are registered and none of them handle the requested algorithm, skipped_non_fips stays NULL and lookup returns NULL silently. The ioctl_init caller logs at that point (line 751-752), so the symptom is observable from dmesg, but any direct caller of crypto2dev_lookup_algo() gets no diagnostic. Consequence at deployment: a FIPS-only deployment that requests an algorithm not covered by any loaded FIPS provider sees silent -ENOENT from lookup with no kernel log explaining whether this is a FIPS enforcement rejection or simply a missing provider.
